comp-mqn2mk7v wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:43px; line-height:1em; text-align:center;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:43px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0.15em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:lulo-clean-w01-one-bold,lulo-clean-w05-one-bold,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Experience&nbsp;</span></span></span></span></h2></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-mqn2mk73" class="comp-mqn2mk73 FDI5TK wixui-column-strip__column"><div id="bgLayers_comp-mqn2mk73" data-hook="bgLayers" data-motion-part="BG_LAYER comp-mqn2mk73" class="QG9w8P"><div data-testid="colorUnderlay" class="LNYVZi ayCf9D"></div><div id="bgMedia_comp-mqn2mk73" data-motion-part="BG_MEDIA comp-mqn2mk73" class="ROWgFb"></div></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-mqn2mk73inlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-mqn2mk73inlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-mqn2mk7w" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-mqn2mk7w wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h3 class="font_3 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:46px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">The Ultimate Snowy Mountains Snowkite Expedition</span></span></h3>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Forget the crowded lift lines and tracked-out resort runs. We&rsquo;re heading beyond the boundaries where the wind howls, the powder stays fresh, and the mountains are yours to conquer.</span></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Welcome to a 6-day, pure-adrenaline backcountry snowkiting expedition in the heart of the Australian Alps. This isn&#39;t just a ski trip; it&rsquo;s a mission. We are utilizing the power of the alpine wind to access massive, untouched bowls, endless ridges, and the kind of terrain you&rsquo;ve only dreamed of riding.</span></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">We&rsquo;ve dialed in the logistics, secured the over-snow transport, and scoped the zones. All you have to do is clip in and send it.</span></span></p>
<h3 class="font_3 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:46px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">The Adventure Blueprint</span></span></h3>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">The Terrain - We&rsquo;re taking you past the limits of Thredbo and Charlotte Pass into the wild expanses of the Main Range. You&rsquo;ll be laying down tracks in iconic backcountry zones like North Rams Head, Cocks Harbour, and the vast, open powder fields of &quot;Splenda.&quot;</span></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">The Dawn Patrol &amp; Snowcat Mission Prepare for the ultimate backcountry strike. On Day 4, we wake before the sun for a hardcore dawn patrol mission. We&rsquo;ll jump aboard an over-snow cat, charging deep into the Charlotte Pass backcountry before the mountain even wakes up. It&rsquo;s an exclusive &quot;Explore Day&quot; dedicated to finding untracked lines and pushing your limits.</span></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">The Descent After a massive day of harnessing the wind, the adventure doesn&#39;t stop. We pack down the kites and carve our way back to civilization, riding the resort runs all the way down to the valley floor.</span></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">The Tribe &amp; The Apr&eacute;s Backcountry riding builds a serious appetite. Every night, we regroup at Jindabyne&rsquo;s best local spots&mdash;swapping stories over cold pints at Jindabyne Brewing, tearing into Japanese feasts at Takayama, and celebrating the trip at Bacco Italian.</span></span></p>
<h3 class="font_3 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:46px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Your Experience Itinerary</span></span></h3>
<ul class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif; font-weight:normal; font-size:15px;">
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Day 1: Basecamp &amp; Briefing. We pick you up from Canberra Airport and make the climb into the mountains. We hit Jindabyne, gear up, and kick off the expedition with a welcome dinner at the Banjo Hotel. The night ends with our first backcountry briefing&mdash;getting our minds right for the mountains.</span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Day 2: First Accent. After rigorous safety and equipment checks, we ride the Thredbo lifts to the edge of the resort. We tour out to North Rams Head, set up our alpine base, and launch the kites. Welcome to the backcountry.</span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Day 3: &quot;Send It&quot; Day. With the terrain scouted, the training wheels come off. Day 3 is all about free rides, long glides, and pushing your progression in the Thredbo backcountry.</span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Day 4: Dawn Patrol &amp; The Snowcat Expedition. A 4:00 AM wake-up call leads to a 45-minute snowcat ride deep into Charlotte Pass. We tour out to the &quot;Splenda&quot; zone for a massive day of raw exploration and untouched snow, finishing with an epic run down to the resort.</span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Day 5: The Final Send. We return to the high alpine above Thredbo for one last massive session. We hit our favorite wind lips and bowls before carving back down to the Valley Terminal. We cap off the expedition with a massive final-night feast and a &quot;dealer&#39;s choice&quot; night out in Jindy.</span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Day 6: Return to Reality. Wake up with tired legs and a camera roll full of epic shots. We pack up the rigs and head back to Canberra Airport for your flight home.</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<blockquote class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px;">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Our Commitment to Safety: The backcountry is wild, and we treat it with respect. Every single morning includes rigorous weather mapping, avalanche beacon verification, buddy pairings, and strict exclusion zone briefings. We manage the risk so you can chase the thrill.</span></span></p>
</blockquote>
<h3 class="font_3 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:46px;"><span style="font-size:46px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Who This Tour is Not For</span></span></span></span></span></h3>
<ul class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif; font-weight:normal; font-size:15px;">
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Recent or chronic shoulder or lower back injuries (the harness and kite pull directly stress these areas).</span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Severe knee issues (the constant edging and choppy snow put high lateral stress on knees).</span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Zero experience on skis or snowboards.</span></span><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">&nbsp;</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="font_3 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:46px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Are You Ready to Drop In?</span></span></h3>
